page.layout: One page of text in a single column; notes in the left margin beside the first lines of the column. Catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Johan. Magn. 1. 4. Histor. Gothic.armis superior, prostrato Fron-tino privatæ victoriæ, publi-cam adjungeret, passimque di-vulsa Danorum[?] agmina pro-fligaret.

Sic itidem Ericus exercitus Norwegiani dux exercitatissi-mus cum Alarico Suenonum Rege duellum suscipit. Et qui certa clade affectus fuisset, si exercitus certamine pugna confecta fuisset, ille victoriam retulit,dum forte privato con-gressui dabatur locus. Prode-unt enim in circum Alaricus & Ericus,acerrimè & infensis-simè utrinque depugnantes. Et quamvis corporum robore ac militari disciplinâ visi sint æquè pares, adeo ut uterque gravissimis plagis affectus in circo corruerit moribundus: certaminis tamen singularis fortuna, quæ Alaricum è vivis confestim abstulit, Ericum æ-grè curatum vitæ restituit,

page.notes: The word after "Danorum" is printed with a mark under the a that looks like an ogonek, so the reading "Danorum" is doubtful. The catchword "Go-" is at the lower right. The faint text at the bottom right corner is the digitiser's mark and is omitted.
